roles.name: 集成与治理
roles.goal: 交付可接续架构/科学指标/迁移方案及治理验证，再协调正式产品分工
roles.done_when: 当前任务满足cursor退出条件，精确证据和下一阶段边界齐全

roles.name: 运行时与内存
roles.goal: R1-M1-WAKE-STOP-002: bounded owner wake/stop race-free publish/armed/recheck using current std-only runtime; R01/R02 and M01 deterministic native proof; do not claim rtrb/loom/OS-event production hot path.
roles.done_when: Own native Rust Actions compile-once consumer proves lost-wakeup/stop/full queue+loan-return interleavings with named R01/R02/M01; keep fresh independent, no std blocking on ready path, no new shared dependencies, S/evidence/H; root SPSC/loom still M0 deferred.

roles.name: 恢复与反馈
roles.goal: R2 pure authenticated-receipt state, bounded shadow repair and time/budget decisions without socket or cipher
roles.done_when: Actions native pure state tests for holes/duplicate/expiry/uncertain with explicit untested integration; no socket/cipher

roles.name: 编码与数据保护
roles.goal: R1 single FrameBudget owner and true independent authenticated record AEAD+8B HP, followed by LINK/FEC
roles.done_when: Pinned old-Go oracle and actual Rust compiled tests for path budget and real cipher boundaries, no fake crypto or product V4

roles.name: 平台与产品接入
roles.goal: R1-M4-IPV4-TCP-READY-002: exact bounded IPv4/TCP-like non-bootstrap DATA packet header+checksum/seq32 wire builder around immutable sealed record, real MTU and reject path; I01/I03 tests; no raw OS TX or V4 admission claim.
roles.done_when: Own native Rust Actions compile-once tests compare actual 20B IPv4+20B TCP header/checksum and seq32 wrap against pinned old-Go facts, <=MTU, odd size/fail closed, frozen record bytes unchanged; S/evidence/H; no AF_PACKET/sendmmsg/Windows native/physical claim.
